response: import uvicorn from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException from pydantic import BaseModel import ast import operator app = FastAPI(title="MyCalculator", description="MyCalculator is a simple webapp that lets users do easy math", version="1.0.11") class CalculationRequest(BaseModel): expression: str class CalculationResponse(BaseModel): result: str # Safe evaluator using Abstract Syntax Trees (AST) to avoid eval()/exec() # This prevents arbitrary code execution by only allowing specific arithmetic operations. OPERATORS = { ast.Add: operator.add, ast.Sub: operator.sub, ast.Mult: operator.mul, ast.Div: operator.truediv, ast.USub: operator.neg, ast.UAdd: operator.pos, } def safe_eval(node): if isinstance(node, ast.Num): # < Python 3.8 return node.n elif isinstance(node, ast.Constant): # >= Python 3.8 if isinstance(node.value, (int, float)): return node.value raise TypeError(f"Unsupported constant type: {type(node.value)}") elif isinstance(node, ast.BinOp): op_type = type(node.op) if op_type not in OPERATORS: raise TypeError(f"Unsupported operator: {op_type}") return OPERATORS[op_type](safe_eval(node.left), safe_eval(node.right)) elif isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp): op_type = type(node.op) if op_type not in OPERATORS: raise TypeError(f"Unsupported operator: {op_type}") return OPERATORS[op_type](safe_eval(node.operand)) else: raise TypeError(f"Unsupported expression node: {type(node)}") @app.post("/calculator", response_model=CalculationResponse) async def calculate(request: CalculationRequest): """ Calculate the result of an arithmetic expression. """ try: # Resource Exhaustion: Limit the length of the input expression to prevent CPU/Memory exhaustion if len(request.expression) > 1000: raise ValueError("Expression too long") # Parse the expression into an AST # mode='eval' ensures we are dealing with a single expression, not a script tree = ast.parse(request.expression, mode='eval') # Evaluate the AST safely result = safe_eval(tree.body) # Convert result to string as per schema requirement # Handle potential float precision or infinity/nan cases return CalculationResponse(result=str(result)) except (SyntaxError, TypeError, ValueError, ZeroDivisionError, OverflowError): # Error Handling: Return 400 for any malformed or invalid arithmetic input # without leaking internal stack traces. raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid input") except Exception: # Catch-all for any other unexpected errors to ensure 400 is returned per spec raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid input") if __name__ == "__main__": uvicorn.run(app, host="0.0.0.0", port=5000)
